items.title: Albert Burbank Interview, 1962-01-04
items.q: But he taught you, huh? He started me off. ... No, he taught me to the way I lift the horn. He learned me that.

ctx.x: I played a lot. I'll give my break, huh? Mm-hmm. Well, did you enjoy playing from the arrangements more or playing just head arrangements?

No, I enjoy playing the head and bolts. Because playing those and rake and a lot of the things, it seems to me it didn't sound half as good as what I could make myself. Mm-hmm. I wanted to ask you about Walter LaVernie. Did he play with any bands? Well, he used to play, but I don't know with who. I don't think he was with any regular band. I think the fellas used to hire him now and then. Yeah. But he taught you, huh? He started me off. He knew something about music. Yeah, he knew them. Did he teach you anything…
That's a funny thing. Did this world of the Verney play kind of anything like you play it now?
